result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and marked crosswalks, but is dominated by wide vehicle travel lanes and a lack of visible pedestrian-specific signals. The environment is primarily commercial/industrial with large asphalt surfaces that prioritize vehicle throughput over pedestrian comfort.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic without a refuge island.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals which may not provide adequate clearance time.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on remaining crossing time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade the standard parallel line crosswalks to continental or ladder patterns to increase visibility to approaching drivers.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and paved sidewalks, providing basic pedestrian infrastructure. However, the wide roadway lacks a median refuge and visible pedestrian signals, increasing exposure and risk in a commercial/industrial setting.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median refuge, increasing exposure time.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible to indicate safe crossing intervals.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic signal poles at the intersection

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-specific signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing instructions.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the intersection to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility.

result.summary: The image shows a commercial driveway entrance intersecting a sidewalk. While sidewalks and curb ramps with detectable warnings are present, the crossing across the wide driveway is unmarked and lacks traffic control for vehicles.

hazards.name: Unmarked Driveway Crossing
hazards.description: The pedestrian path across the wide commercial driveway lacks markings, providing no clear guidance for pedestrians or warning for drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground where the sidewalk meets the driveway

hazards.name: Wide Curb Radius
hazards.description: The wide entrance allows for higher vehicle turning speeds, increasing risk to pedestrians on the sidewalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right and left sides of the driveway entrance

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility (continental) marked crosswalk across the driveway to clearly define the pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Implement a raised crosswalk across the driveway to slow entering/exiting vehicles and maintain the sidewalk level.

interventions.title: Stop Control for Driveway
interventions.description: Add a stop sign and stop bar for vehicles exiting the commercial property to ensure they yield to pedestrians.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a wide multi-lane roadway with a high-visibility continental crosswalk and a paved sidewalk. However, the lack of a median refuge, curb extensions, or clearly visible pedestrian signals increases exposure for people crossing in a high-speed commercial corridor.

hazards.name: Long unprotected crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground at the marked crosswalk

hazards.name: High-speed road geometry
hazards.description: Wide, straight lanes and a lack of vertical traffic calming elements like street trees may encourage high vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles receive a green light.
